# Host captures (not run)

Status: `not_run`. These fixtures are captured from a real OpenClaw
v2026.10.7 install pointed at `scripts/capture_host_requests.mjs`; no
host capture has been made yet. The commands are in
[`../../../../README.md`](../../../../README.md#host-capture-operator).

review it before committing it: replace any local path or name the
capture script did not already replace with `<home>`.
